subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should maintainers require redacted Telegram owner-session delivery proof before merge, or intentionally accept source/test proof for this PR?
rationale: The code shape is narrow, but the changed behavior is visible channel/session delivery and the existing Mantis proof run skipped, so automation should not waive the live-proof bar on its own.

options.title: Require Telegram Delivery Proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact proving owner-topic delivery with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Risk
options.body: A maintainer may intentionally merge on source and regression-test proof only, while owning the remaining real transport/session delivery risk.

options.title: Pause For Broader Contract
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the fix folded into a wider detached-subagent liveness and terminal-delivery contract.

recommendation.title: Require Telegram Delivery Proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact proving owner-topic delivery with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest relevant history on subagent announce delivery and can judge whether source-level proof is enough for this session/channel delivery change.
